rising.title: An extensible deep learning framework for multi-type chromatin interaction prediction through hierarchical adaptation strategies
rising.title_zh: 一个通过分层适应策略进行多类型染色质相互作用预测的可扩展深度学习框架
rising.summary_zh: 三维染色质相互作用在基因调控中起重要作用，然而多种相互作用类型的计算预测在很大程度上仍依赖于专门的单任务模型。在这里，我们提出UniLoopNet，一个多任务深度学习框架，可从DNA序列预测多种类型的染色质相互作用，包括增强子-启动子相互作用、增强子-增强子相互作用、CTCF介导的环和条纹相关相互作用。UniLoopNet采用共享编码器-解码器架构和分层适应策略，基于任务语义相似性整合多任务、迁移和持续学习。跨多个细胞系的全面基准测试表明，UniLoopNet优于现有的专门和多任务方法，大多数任务的AUROC超过0.90。在严格评估设置下，包括染色体匹配、距离匹配、现实不平衡和位点不相交测试，AUROC范围为0.8934至0.9366。在现实的1:5类别不平衡设置中，增强子-启动子和增强子-增强子相互作用预测的AUPRC分别为0.7956和0.6935。跨细胞系迁移实验进一步表明，将Uni

extra.description: Three-dimensional chromatin interactions play essential roles in gene regulation, yet computational prediction of diverse interaction types remains largely dependent on specialized, single-task models. Here, we present UniLoopNet, a multi-task deep learning framework that predicts multiple types of chromatin interactions including enhancer–promoter interactions, enhancer–enhancer interactions, CTCF-mediated loops, and stripe-associated interactions from DNA sequences. UniLoopNet employs a shared encoder–decoder architecture with hierarchical adaptation strategies, integrating multi-task, transfer, and continual learning based on task semantic similarity. Comprehensive benchmarking across multiple cell lines demonstrates that UniLoopNet outperforms existing specialized and multi-task approaches, with AUROCs exceeding 0.90 in most tasks. Under stringent evaluation settings, including chromosome-matched, distance-matched, realistic imbalanced, and locus-disjoint tests, AUROCs range from 0.8934 to 0.9366. In the realistic 1:5 class-imbalance setting, the AUPRCs for enhancer–promoter and enhancer–enhancer interaction prediction are 0.7956 and 0.6935, respectively. Cross-cell-line transfer experiments further show that applying UniLoopNet to another cell line requires adaptation by supervised fine-tuning on target-cell-line data, after which performance is comparable to that of within-cell-line training. Notably, the framework exhibits data efficiency in experiments with substantially reduced training data. Interpretability analyses reveal that the learned sequence features are associated with known transcription factor binding sites and uncover differential regulatory effects of disease-associated variants. UniLoopNet provides a versatile and data-efficient framework for sequence-based prediction and interpretation of diverse 3D genome interactions, complementing existing sequence-to-map approaches while improving the understanding of sequence-encoded regulatory potential.

rising.title: CALT-GNN: a graph neural network with cross-attention and long-tail experts for multi-omics cancer subtype classification
rising.title_zh: CALT-GNN：一种用于多组学癌症亚型分类的交叉注意力和长尾专家图神经网络
rising.summary_zh: 摘要 基于分子特征的癌症亚型分类对于表征肿瘤异质性、评估患者预后和支持精准治疗很重要。多组学整合提供了基因组、表观基因组、转录组和蛋白质组层面的互补分子信息。然而，多组学数据的高维性、复杂的跨组学关系和不平衡的亚型分布仍是主要挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出CALT-GNN，一种图神经网络框架，整合患者相似性图学习、基于交叉注意力的组学整合、长尾专家分类和可学习预测融合。该框架首先构建组学特异性患者相似性图，使用图卷积网络学习潜在患者表示，并通过相似性网络融合获得统一图。交叉注意力分支将CNA和DNA甲基化作为源模态，mRNA表达作为目标模态，建模互补关系。并行地，长尾专家分支使用主要和次要专家，配合原型引导路由，执行类别分布感知分类。两个分支的输出随后使用可学习全局权重组合。在八个TCGA多组学队列上的实验表明，CALT-GNN相对于代表性基线方法取得了有竞争力或可比的分类性能，并在对类别

extra.description: Abstract Cancer subtype classification based on molecular features is important for characterizing tumor heterogeneity, evaluating patient prognosis, and supporting precision treatment. Multi-omics integration provides complementary molecular information across genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic levels. However, the high dimensionality of multi-omics data, complex cross-omics relationships, and imbalanced subtype distributions remain major challenges. To address these issues, we propose CALT-GNN, a graph neural network framework that integrates patient-similarity graph learning, cross-attention-based omics integration, long-tail expert classification, and learnable prediction fusion. The framework first constructs omics-specific patient-similarity graphs, learns latent patient representations using graph convolutional networks, and obtains a unified graph through similarity network fusion. A cross-attention branch models complementary relationships between CNA and DNA methylation as source modalities and mRNA expression as the target modality. In parallel, a long-tail expert branch uses Major and Minor Experts with prototype-guided routing to perform class-distribution-aware classification. The outputs of the two branches are subsequently combined using a learnable global weight. Experiments on eight TCGA multi-omics cohorts showed that CALT-GNN achieved competitive or comparable classification performance relative to representative baseline methods and stable performance on Macro-F1 and MCC, which are sensitive to class imbalance. Ablation and subtype-level analyses further supported the complementary contributions of cross-omics interaction modeling and adaptive long-tail expert routing, although the magnitude of the improvements varied across cohorts and subtypes. These results suggest that CALT-GNN provides a methodological framework for multi-omics cancer subtype classification under complex cross-omics relationships and imbalanced subtype distributions.

extra.description: Population-scale genome resources remain biased toward European ancestry, limiting variant interpretation in underrepresented populations. Here, we expanded the Human Genetic Variation Database (HGVD), a free Japanese allele-frequency resource launched in 2013. HGVD v3.1 integrates 1209 exomes with whole-genome sequencing (WGS) data from 3135 Japanese individuals selected by principal component analysis (PCA) to span genetic diversity, providing aggregate variant statistics for 4344 individuals, 3248 genotyped individuals, and expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) from 300 individuals. For research and clinical use, HGVD provides coordinated JBrowse-based browsers for GRCh37/hg19, GRCh38/hg38, and T2T-CHM13. The non-GRCh37 variant tracks were generated by liftOver from the GRCh37 call set. Variant frequencies, sample counts, and coverage are available across assemblies, whereas eQTL annotations are currently available only on hg19. A downloadable, graph-genome-ready structural-variant release is provided, and the new pathSTR portal reports population-level distributions for 68 medically relevant tandem-repeat loci, derived by applying STRdust to long-read Oxford Nanopore data from 1019 individuals of the 1000 Genomes Project remapped to T2T-CHM13. HGVD v3.1 supports population-matched interpretation of rare pathogenic and pharmacogenomic variants, comparison of repeat-expansion alleles with long-read reference distributions, and structural-variant-aware reference construction, supporting precision medicine for Japan and East Asian populations. HGVD is available at https://www.hgvd.genome.med.kyoto-u.ac.jp/.

new_today.title_zh: Starlng：共调控基因“巢”的稳定性分析。
new_today.summary_zh: 单细胞检测（单组学和多组学）代表了细胞表型详细表征的最先进技术，该任务通常以识别与明确、稳定的细胞亚群相关的基因群为起点。基因表达共变模式是基因调控网络（GRNs）的简化前体，在推断GRNs内的因果性和动态性方面发挥关键作用。然而，当前的基因聚类方法难以捕捉沿发育轨迹的空间组织和关系动态，同时仍易受噪声和算法随机性的影响。在ClustAssess框架的基础上——该框架将细胞群体的以聚类为中心的评估转变为以元素为中心的视角——我们提出评估基因图聚类诱导的共变。Starlng（缩写）框架为识别过滤后的模块提供了优化的交互式环境。该流程识别聚类参数的稳定配置和稳健的基因模块（基因巢），随后基于伪时间方差去除离群聚类。我们展示了Starlng在识别可靠、可重复的基因群落方面的应用，并揭示了更高层级细胞聚类与更细粒度基因亚群之间的无偏层级关系。Starlng以R实现，可在https://github

extra.description: Single-cell assays (both single and multi-omics) represent the state-of-the-art for detailed characterisation of cell phenotypes, a task frequently initialised with the identification of groups of genes linked to well-defined, stable subpopulations of cells. Gene expression covariation patterns are simplified precursors of Gene Regulatory Networks (GRNs), and play a crucial role in inferring causality and dynamics within GRNs. However, current gene clustering methods struggle to capture spatial organisation and relationship dynamics along developmental trajectories, while remaining vulnerable to noise and algorithmic stochasticity. Expanding on the ClustAssess framework, which shifted the cluster-centric assessment of populations of cells to an element-centric perspective, we propose to assess the covariation induced by gene graph clustering. The Starlng (abbrev) framework provides an optimised, interactive environment for the identification of the filtered modules. The pipeline identifies the stable configuration of clustering parameters and robust gene modules (nests of genes), followed by the removal of the outlier clusters based on the pseudotime variance. We illustrate Starlng on the identification of reliable, reproducible communities of genes, as well as reveal unbiased hierarchical relationships between higher-level cell clusters and more granular subgroups of genes. Starlng is implemented in R and freely available at https://github.com/Core-Bioinformatics/Starlng . Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

dropped.title: Single-cell landscape of human adipose tissue reveals THBS1 as a potential driver of fibro-inflammation in metabolic disease.
dropped.title_zh: 人类脂肪组织的单细胞景观揭示THBS1是代谢疾病中纤维炎症的潜在驱动因素。
dropped.summary_zh: 脂肪组织的细胞复杂性在代谢疾病发病机制中起关键作用；然而，脂肪功能障碍的机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们构建了来自一个种族同质队列的人类内脏脂肪组织的单核和批量转录组图谱，该队列具有明确的代谢状态：瘦且糖耐量正常、肥胖、肥胖伴2型糖尿病。单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）揭示了一个以高THBS1表达为特征的脂肪干细胞和脂肪细胞的纤维炎症亚群，与瘦对照组相比，这些细胞在肥胖和肥胖伴2型糖尿病个体中富集。通过互补的体外（人原代ASCs、THP-1巨噬细胞和Matrigel捕获的成熟脂肪细胞）、离体（小鼠和人类内脏脂肪组织外植体）和体内（功能获得和抗体介导的中和）实验，我们证明THBS1通过巨噬细胞介导的TGFβ激活促进脂肪纤维化和炎症，损害脂肪生成和脂肪细胞功能。抑制THBS1减轻代谢功能障碍脂肪组织中的纤维炎症特征。此外，血浆和脂肪细胞中的THBS1水平与代谢特征相关，包括BMI和HbA1c。

extra.description: The cellular complexity of adipose tissue plays a critical role in the pathogenesis of metabolic disease; however, mechanisms underlying adipose dysfunction remain poorly understood. Here, we constructed a single-nucleus and bulk transcriptomic atlas of human visceral adipose tissues from an ethnically homogeneous cohort with defined metabolic states: lean with normal glucose tolerance, obesity, and obesity with type 2 diabetes. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) revealed a fibro-inflammatory subpopulation of adipose stem cells and adipocytes characterized by high THBS1 expression, which were enriched in individuals with obesity and obesity with type 2 diabetes compared to lean controls. Through complementary in vitro (human primary ASCs, THP-1 macrophages, and Matrigel-captured mature adipocytes), ex vivo (mouse and human visceral adipose tissue explants), and in vivo (gain-of-function and antibody-mediated neutralization) experiments, we demonstrated that THBS1 promoted adipose fibrosis and inflammation via macrophage-mediated TGFβ activation, impairing adipogenesis and adipocyte function. Inhibition of THBS1 attenuated fibro-inflammatory features in metabolically dysfunctional adipose tissues. Moreover, THBS1 levels in plasma and adipocytes correlated with metabolic traits, including BMI and HbA1c. Collectively, our study provides a cellular atlas of human visceral adipose tissues across metabolic disease states and identifies THBS1 as a key pathogenic driver and potential therapeutic target.

dropped.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，据彭博社 10 月 25 日报道，与几年前相比，Netflix 用户每月打开应用的天数有所减少，人均观看时长也有所下降。 据介绍，这一趋势始于 2022 年 Netflix 开始打击密码共享行为之后。管理层起初认为这只是短期现象，因为每个账户对应的使用人数减少，但此后这一趋势仍在延续。用户观看时间减少，可能意味着他们认为该服务提供的价值有所下降，或者将更多时间花在竞争对手的平台上。 消息人士指出，Netflix 使用 QPD（Qualified Play Days）指标衡量用户使用应用的频率。2026 年上半年，Netflix 应用的总使用时长仅增长了几个百分点，但这主要原因是用户数量增长，而非单个用户观看时长增加。 为吸引新用户并留住现有用户，Netflix 增加了内容制作预算，并拓展播客、体育赛事直播等业务类别。不过，Netflix 联席首席执行官泰德

dropped.title: HRD: an integrated multi-omics resource for human reproduction and development
dropped.title_zh: HRD：人类生殖与发育的综合多组学资源
dropped.summary_zh: 摘要 人类生殖与发育是一个由遗传、分子和环境因素塑造的连续过程。然而，相关数据仍分散在公共存储库和文献中，限制了系统整合、分析和再利用。我们开发了人类生殖与发育数据库（HRD；http://www.inbirg.com/hrd/），这是一个综合多组学资源，组织与多个生殖、妊娠和发育背景相关的公开可用数据。HRD 1.0版包含814条组学记录，包括432条批量转录组、144条单细胞或单核转录组、156条表观基因组、52条代谢组和30条蛋白质组记录，以及702条临床试验记录、293条暴露-结局关联和779个带有 curated 表型关联的先导SNP。通过协调关键元数据并应用数据类型特定的分析工作流，HRD将组学数据、遗传关联、暴露-结局证据和临床试验数据纳入一个共同框架，以探索生殖和发育多个阶段的数据。该网站支持关键词搜索、组合筛选、基于类别的浏览、统计摘要和数据下载，并提供差异分析、功能富集

extra.description: Abstract Human reproduction and development span a continuum shaped by genetic, molecular, and environmental factors. However, relevant data remain dispersed across public repositories and the literature, limiting systematic integration, analysis, and reuse. We developed the Human Reproduction and Development Database (HRD; http://www.inbirg.com/hrd/), an integrated multi-omics resource that organizes publicly available data relevant to multiple reproductive, pregnancy, and developmental contexts. HRD version 1.0 contains 814 omics records, including 432 bulk transcriptomic, 144 single-cell or single-nucleus transcriptomic, 156 epigenomic, 52 metabolomic, and 30 proteomic records, together with 702 clinical trial records, 293 exposure-outcome associations, and 779 lead SNPs with curated phenotype associations. By harmonising key metadata and applying data-type-specific analysis workflows, HRD brings omics data, genetic associations, exposure-outcome evidence, and clinical trial data into a common framework for exploring data from multiple stages of reproduction and development. The website supports keyword search, combined filtering, category-based browsing, statistical summaries and data downloads, and provides interactive visualizations of differential analyses, functional enrichment, cell clustering, chromatin accessibility, peak annotation, regulatory networks, and cross-phenotype association plots. HRD supports the retrieval, comparison, and reuse of reproductive and developmental data and analysis results.

extra.description: Abstract Cancer subtype classification based on molecular features is important for characterizing tumor heterogeneity, evaluating patient prognosis, and supporting precision treatment. Multi-omics integration provides complementary molecular information across genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic levels. However, the high dimensionality of multi-omics data, complex cross-omics relationships, and imbalanced subtype distributions remain major challenges. To address these issues, we propose CALT-GNN, a graph neural network framework that integrates patient-similarity graph learning, cross-attention-based omics integration, long-tail expert classification, and learnable prediction fusion. The framework first constructs omics-specific patient-similarity graphs, learns latent patient representations using graph convolutional networks, and obtains a unified graph through similarity network fusion. A cross-attention branch models complementary relationships between CNA and DNA methylation as source modalities and mRNA expression as the target modality. In parallel, a long-tail expert branch uses Major and Minor Experts with prototype-guided routing to perform class-distribution-aware classification. The outputs of the two branches are subsequently combined using a learnable global weight. Experiments on eight TCGA multi-omics cohorts showed that CALT-GNN achieved competitive or comparable classification performance relative to representative baseline methods and stable performance on Macro-F1 and MCC, which are sensitive to class imbalance. Ablation and subtype-level analyses further supported the complementary contributions of cross-omics interaction modeling and adaptive long-tail expert routing, although the magnitude of the improvements varied across cohorts and subtypes. These results suggest that CALT-GNN provides a methodological framework for multi-omics cancer subtype classification under complex cross-omics relationships and imbalanced subtype distributions.

longest_on_board.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
longest_on_board.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

longest_on_board.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
longest_on_board.title_zh: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 随着云计算与空天地海一体化通信网络的深度融合, 各种复杂应用场景的出现使得组合服务的种类和数量急剧增多, 结构也变得复杂。在云网融合环境下, 用户移动设备和边缘服务器等硬件能力有限, 能耗问题成为组合服务进行动态重构不可忽略的重要因素。此外, 传统方法并未考虑空天地海不同场景下用户对不同服务质量(QoS)属性需求的差异性, 使得组合服务的交付结果并不令人满意。为了解决上述问题, 提出一种基于多目标粒子群优化(PSO)的组合服务动态重构方法。该方法首先根据重构原子服务的三维空间地理位置和功能进行聚类, 有效解决在云网融合环境下服务规模庞大情况下的搜索空间爆炸问题; 然后通过能耗计算模型得到服务调用的综合能耗, 并将其作为动态重构的优化目标之一, 结合服务的多种QoS属性进行多目标寻优, 最终生成符合用户需求且能耗较低的重构方案。实验结果表明, 该方法在云网融合环境下节约能耗和应对较大候选服务

longest_on_board.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
longest_on_board.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。
